column3: The Hebrew repeats “in every city and city”; BSB says “in all the cities.”
The Hebrew says they stood with “him”; BSB explicitly names Rehoboam.
The Hebrew leaves the subject unnamed here and says “calves”; BSB names Jeroboam and specifies “calf idols.”
The Hebrew calls the LORD “the God of Israel”; BSB says “their God.”
The Hebrew places Abihail after the lineage through Jerimoth without a joining word; BSB supplies and of to identify Mahalath’s maternal line.
The Hebrew says he took eighteen wives and uses an active fathering verb for his children; BSB says he had wives and was the father of the children.
The Hebrew says he sought many wives without explicitly saying “for them,” which BSB supplies.
